name: Zaque's Game
detailed_description:
Zaque's Game is a story-driven strategy game about playing a card game against a serial killer named Zaque. Trapped in a dark, unknown room, playing the game is your only choice. However, there's a catch. If you are to lose Zaque's game you also lose your life.

This is only the first chapter in a large string of bread crumbs. Investigate and learn about Zaque, play and beat him at his own game, uncover the story and motives, and work to figure out why these murders are taking place.



Features:
▪ Intense and fun card game.
▪ Challenging and engaging story mode.
▪ Difficult and satisfying extras challenges that unlocks extra story.
▪ Endless replay-ability
▪ Fantastic voice acting
▪ Easy to learn, difficult to master.
▪ Real detective feel.

short_description: A strategy, survival, horror game in which you play a card game against a serial killer. Take turns placing cards, watch out for matches and face cards, slap faster than your opponent and steal the whole deck!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit, Windows 8.1, Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4330/AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB/ AMD Radeon R7 370 2GB
  • Storage: 90 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game shows light depictions of guns and murder. However, there is no gore.
